beforeStory: Surrendered after his previous owner fell ill, Waffles spent four anxious weeks hiding behind his kennel bedding.
afterStory: Today, Waffles is the official morale officer at Sarah's architectural studio, greeting clients and hiking mountain trails every weekend.
quote: FurEver Care didn't just find us a pet; they connected us with a family member who fills our home with infinite laughter.

beforeStory: Senior cats often wait 4x longer for adoption. Cleo spent 180 days patiently hoping someone would overlook her age.
afterStory: Cleo now presides over David's writing desk, sunbathing on his manuscripts and purring like a gentle engine throughout the day.
quote: Adopting a senior cat was the most rewarding decision of my life. Her gratitude and tenderness are unmatched.

beforeStory: Found as orphaned kits in an urban park, they required around-the-clock syringe feeding by our volunteer fosters.
afterStory: Now healthy, curious bonded house bunnies who perform joyful binkies across the living room carpet every afternoon.
quote: The shelter adoption team guided our kids through rabbit care with so much patience and kindness.
